extracted.name: Tandoori Chicken rolls
extracted.description: Great recipe for Tandoori Chicken rolls.
ingredient_lines: 250 g maida (can substitute with all-purpose flour)
instruction_lines: Take maida in a bowl add oil egg soda and active yeast and make dough keep it for one hour.
Take boneless chicken and add above ingredients and cook for 15 mins.
Take a dough and make a roll and add chicken filling in it.add lots of grated cheese.
Bake this at 200 degree celsius for 10mins
Rolls are ready to eat. U can eat with tomato sauce or mayonisse
